_note: Ground truth per object for door_room_v1. 'id' = the Gazebo label on that model (unique per object, 1-255). Classes: 1 = door, 2 = handle. Hinge side, push/pull and slide direction are seen from the camera side of the wall. World frame: x toward the wall, y left, z up (metres). hinge_world / slide_world = a point + direction from the joints in door_room_v1.sdf. 'joint' = how run_room.sh opens the door (open = command it sends). front_world = door centre on the wall face + the direction the door faces (toward the camera side), used to place viewpoints. Objects with class null are parts of another object (part_of), e.g. a glass pane: merge into the parent for segmentation, no box of their own.

camera.frame: ROS optical: x right, y down, z forward
